name: New York
short: In New York your heat pump rebate depends on your electric utility. NYS Clean Heat pays up to $10,000 through Con Edison, National Grid, NYSEG and RG&E, up to $9,000 through Orange & Rockland and up to $8,000 through Central Hudson. PSEG Long Island runs its own program at $4,000 to $7,500. Income-eligible homes can get free upgrades through EmPower+. The federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.
